maturity.basis: Engineering estimate; scheduling proposals alone do not prove a productive executed loop.
maturity.changeReason: No increase until the newly implemented generic scheduling capability is exercised through real execution and feedback.

limitations: This is pinned public receipt replay, not a fresh live authority snapshot or Agent execution.
Available lanes are operator declarations, not execution attestations.
The planner does not execute proposals or write TableGit; existing gates still own execution and persistence.
Calibrated cases, execution, feedback into the next knowledge cut and cross-repository transfer remain explicit downstream requirements.
